# Gracie Abrams Lights Up New York City for SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series on October 24


October 01, 2026 12:00pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_de62d33c812fd365ee73a6cc95c07066/siriusxm/news/2026-10-01_Gracie_Abrams_Lights_Up_New_York_City_for_2307.pdf)


***Special performance at Irving Plaza to air across multiple SiriusXM channels***


**NEW YORK, NY – October 1, 2026** – SiriusXM today announced that GRAMMY® nominated singer songwriter **Gracie Abrams** will take center stage for a special SiriusXM exclusive show on October 24 at Irving Plaza in New York City.


Ahead of her highly anticipated tour kicking off in December, this intimate show, which is part of SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series presented by Hershey’s, will showcase the pop icon performing songs from her latest album, Daughter from Hell, as well as her beloved hits.


SiriusXM subscribers can tune in to hear the performance airing on SiriusXM Hits 1 (ch. 2) on October 30 at 9:00 pm ET, October 31 at 3:00 pm ET and November 1 at 7:00 pm ET. Select songs will also air on The Pulse, Unwell Music and The Coffee House. The concert will also be available anytime on the SiriusXM app.


“Gracie Abrams is one of the most compelling artists of her generation, and the connection she has built with her audience is remarkable,” said Scott Greenstein, SiriusXM’s President and Chief Content Officer. “SiriusXM has always been about bringing artists and fans closer together, and the Small Stage Series creates the kind of intimate, unforgettable experience you simply can’t get anywhere else. We’re excited to have Gracie take the stage and give our listeners a night they’ll remember.”


SiriusXM subscribers and fans can enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to the show presented by Hershey’s - click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/gracieabramstixOL?utm_campaign=SXM_Programming_BAU&utm_medium=press-release&utm_source=2026_10_NA-SiriusXMHits1-GeneralProgramming-GracieAbramsSmallStageSeries-GeneralBAU) for full details. If you do not live in the New York City area, you can also enter for your chance to win a VIP trip to the concert - click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/gracieabramstripOL?utm_campaign=SXM_Programming_BAU&utm_medium=press-release&utm_source=2026_10_NA-SiriusXMHits1-GeneralProgramming-GracieAbramsSmallStageSeries-GeneralBAU) for full details. At the show Hershey’s will treat fans to a flavorful on-site experience with exclusive surprises, giveaways and product sampling.


Gracie Abrams’ show continues SiriusXM’s exclusive ongoing Small Stage Series featuring performances with premier artists spanning music genres and styles held in small iconic venues. SiriusXM launched its Small Stage Series in August 2021 and to date has included performances by artists including Alicia Keys, Brandi Carlile, Coldplay, Dave Matthews, Ed Sheeran, Green Day, H.E.R., Hilary Duff, J Balvin, J. Cole, Jason Aldean, Kane Brown, Kenny Chesney, Lainey Wilson and more.

**ABOUT GRACIE ABRAMS**
Since making her debut in 2019, Gracie Abrams has emerged as one of the most compelling singer-songwriters of her generation. Penning her first song at age eight, she went on to amass a devoted following with EPs minor (2020) and This Is What It Feels Like (2021), before embarking on a sold-out North American tour in 2022. Her debut album, Good Riddance (2023), sparked another headline tour that sold out in under one hour and earned Abrams the highly-coveted nomination for Best New Artist at the 66th Annual GRAMMY® Awards. Abrams then toured with Taylor Swift as the opening act on select dates of the blockbuster Eras Tour.


In 2024, Abrams released her sophomore album The Secret of Us, which became her first #1 album in the UK, Australia, and the Netherlands, and debuted at #2 on the Billboard 200. Its breakout single “Close To You” marked her first solo Billboard Hot 100 debut, while “us.” featuring Taylor Swift earned Abrams her second GRAMMY® nod, this time for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance. Its deluxe track “That’s So True” reached #1 on the US Spotify chart, entered Spotify’s Billions Club with over 1.5 billion streams, and became her first Billboard Hot 100 Top 10 hit. Abrams spent 2024 on TheSecret of Us world tour, and 2025 on The Secret of Us Deluxe Tour, her first solo North American arena run.


Beyond music, Abrams has cemented her presence in the fashion world as global house ambassador for Chanel, fronting the brand’s Spring-Summer 2025 Pre-Collection campaign before being unveiled as a muse for the Coco Crush collection. Most recently, she became the face of Coco Mademoiselle Crush Absolu. As her artistry continues to expand, Abrams is set to make her acting debut in the upcoming A24 film Please. She also released her highly anticipated third studio album, Daughter from Hell, on July 17th.
